dataset: FLARE screening shine: IAEA ENSDF reference-mixture photons, ANS GP concrete, ICRP74 ROT

sources.photons: IAEA Livechart ENSDF decay_rads gamma; https://www-nds.iaea.org/relnsd/v1/data; extracted2026-10-22
sources.weights: NUREG/CR-4467 Table A1; same60-nuclide reference set as nbt_groups.json
sources.attenuation_and_buildup: ANSI/ANS6.4.3-1991/SCALE data as transcribed in AlanFord/ZapMeNot src/zapmenot/materialLibrary.yml
sources.fluence_effective_dose: ICRP74 tables A.1 and A.17, ROT; OpenMC openmc/data/dose/icrp74/photons.txt

notes: Fixed group spectra; no isotope-dependent decay hardening or daughter ingrowth.
Photons below15keV omitted; no beta bremsstrahlung. Missing observed intensities excluded and counted in audit.
Group gamma yields weighted by initial nuclide activity; ICRP74 effective dose is not identical to historical FGR12 EDE.
GP exposure buildup approximates effective-dose buildup; freeze GP depth at40mfp, retain actual exponential beyond40.
Only airborne containment source represented; removed/deposited/sump/fuel sources and skyshine omitted.
Plume uses FGR12 group cloud DCF times a photon-spectrum-weighted normal-slab transmission; not a finite-plume transport solution.
